B33.name: 湖心巨鲤
B33.form: a deep oval body with a rounded belly, a large blunt head, a small terminal mouth, two pairs of long barbels at the mouth corners, large cycloid scales
B33.fins: a long-based dorsal fin, a short anal fin, a large forked tail fin
B33.markings: a line of raised scales along the flank
B33.colour: 湖心青灰底、金边大鳞，须端浅银

B34.name: 百斤鳡王
B34.form: a long slender pike-like body, a pointed conical head, a large terminal mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding, rows of sharp teeth, small scales
B34.fins: a long dorsal fin, pointed pectoral fins, a deeply forked tail fin
B34.markings: a faint line along the mid-flank
B34.colour: 水虎青底、背脊深纹，牙口惨白

A46.name: 白浪之神·大青针
A46.form: a very long slender needle-like body, jaws drawn out into a long thin beak lined with fine teeth, small set eyes, a straight lateral line
A46.fins: small set-back pectoral fins, a dorsal fin set far back near the tail, a slightly forked tail fin
A46.markings: a thin line running along the flank
A46.colour: 白浪银底、背线深青，针吻冷白

S01.name: 深海鳕
S01.form: an elongated body tapering to a slim tail stock, a large head, a blunt snout, a small barbel under the chin, small cycloid scales
S01.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin
S01.markings: a line running along the mid-flank
S01.colour: 冷灰底、腹部浅白，须端深色

S06.name: 深海鲷
S06.form: a laterally compressed deep body, a steep forehead, a small terminal mouth, a large eye, ctenoid scales
S06.fins: a long dorsal fin with a distinct spiny front section, a short anal fin, a forked tail fin
S06.markings: a small blotch at the base of the tail fin
S06.colour: 深海墨青底、背棘冷金，腹面浅灰

S08.name: 幽灵鳍鱼
S08.form: a slender soft body, a small blunt head, a small mouth, thin translucent fins draped like loose cloth
S08.fins: long translucent dorsal and anal fins draped along the body, small pectoral fins, a rounded tail fin
S08.markings: faint seams between the fin membranes
S08.colour: 幽影深青底、鳍缘透明，光点稀疏

S17.name: 深海水母
S17.form: a rounded blunt dome bell, a thin even margin, dense short tentacles set close around the rim, four abbreviated oral arms
S17.markings: evenly spaced luminous pores along the bell margin
S17.colour: 深青灰底、伞缘冷白，触手淡蓝

S24.name: 无光鳕
S24.form: a moderately proportioned body, a large head, a blunt snout, a small chin barbel, small scales, low sensory pores along the head
S24.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin
S24.markings: a line of sensory pores along the head and flank
S24.colour: 无光黑蓝底、哑光，须端深灰

S39.name: 黑柔骨鱼
S39.form: a slender dark body, a large head, extremely long jaws forming an open gape with no floor to the mouth, fang-like teeth of mixed size, small eyes, naked scaleless skin
S39.fins: small pectoral fins, a dorsal fin set far back on the body, an anal fin set opposite the dorsal, a small forked tail fin
S39.markings: a row of luminous pores along the flank, a large luminous patch below the eye
S39.colour: 通体漆黑，眼下发光器深红，体侧光点稀疏

S40.name: 深海水母王
S40.form: a huge flattened dome bell, a thick folded margin, very long trailing tentacles grouped in a few thick clusters, four long frilled oral arms
S40.markings: a ring of luminous pores along the bell margin, faint radial seams across the dome
S40.colour: 王青蓝底、伞缘熔金，触手冷白
